content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelors degree in science / 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. Basic hands-on experience in buffer preparation, PCR techniques, biochemical assays, and biophysical characterization experiments. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. For the discipline-specific eligibility, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 20,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. HRA is payable as applicable. An increment of 15% is given for 3 years of experience, with a maximum ceiling of 4 such revisions, i.e. up to 12 years of experience. The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The assignment is described as temporary.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant posts has IIT Kharagpur advertised?
faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur has advertised 1 post of Project Assistant - Nano Fabrication in the Department of Nano Science and Technology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelors degree in science / 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. Basic hands-on experience in buffer preparation, PCR techniques, biochemical assays and biophysical characterization experiments is desired.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 20,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. HRA is payable as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice states the application fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project, with a tenure of 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Do pay increments apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives an increment of 15% for 3 years of experience, with a maximum ceiling of 4 such revisions, i.e. up to 12 years of experience.

faq.question: Q10. Does meeting the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
